summary: 120-foot state fire lookout on the Windsor road, Isle of Wight County, in service from December 1936; dismantled in 1993 and planned for reassembly at a shooting range.

facts.status_note: Dismantled in January 1993. Reassembly about a mile away was planned; the sources read do not confirm it was done.

access.note: The 1993 owners ran Southwind Shooting Farms, a fee-based range; a 1992 article describes it as open to the public for a $20 fee.

events.note: Procured and erected by the Virginia Conservation and Development Commission; placed in operation December 1936

notes_for_editor: Built, staffing and the 1993 dismantling rest on a volunteer history page that transcribes 1936-1993 Smithfield Times articles; the newspapers were not opened directly (the Virginia Chronicle copy returned 403). The 1993 article says reassembly was planned; no source read confirms the tower stands at the range or that the range still operates. The record's agency is the current Virginia Department of Forestry; the 1936 article credits the Virginia Conservation and Development Commission.
